# Contract test corpus

[中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Acceptance procedure](../../docs/testing.md)

There are **12 contract files and 11 case IDs**; C06 is a two-version case. Fixtures and expected results are test design, not proof of completed acceptance.

## Provenance

- C01–C08: synthetic contracts with invented identities and intentional test conditions; nine files including C06a/b. C07 is a synthetic English Singapore-law MSA, not a real client contract.
- R01: a public blank government-procurement template. Source provenance is recorded in [ground-truth.yaml](ground-truth.yaml). It is not an executed agreement.
- R02: a generated, filled derivative of R01. [make-r02.py](make-r02.py) inserts names, dates and signature text, and deliberately introduces an arbitration-institution defect. The historical filename “executed” is a scenario label, not authentication of execution.
- R03: a temporal derivative of R02 generated by [make-r03.py](make-r03.py), changing dates and reference years to exercise historical-law handling.

There is no authorized real customer executed-contract acceptance demonstrated by these fixtures. Public origin does not remove the need to record transformations or verify legal conclusions.

C01 checks false positives; C02 hard input defects; C03 missing clauses and conditional continuation; C04 employment issues; C05 conflicting jurisdiction/data terms; C06 attachment-aware version comparison; C07 English and out-of-service-scope handling; C08 signature-state handling. R01 tests template intake, R02 downstream analysis, and R03 temporal applicability. Business benchmark values are fixture/pack assumptions, not universal market or legal standards.

## Known oracle limitations

- Canonical runtime gate values are passed, conditional and blocked. R02/R03 still contain legacy pass; the intended passing spelling is passed. This documentation update does not modify their oracle.
- C05 and C07 are conditional in the oracle; the previous README incorrectly said passed.
- Historical oracle comments about cn-v1 or missing Singapore packs must not override the current CN-only service boundary. Out-of-scope general governance is distinct from a supported-jurisdiction pack error.
- Signature expectations depend on requested scope: an explicitly established unsigned negotiation draft is not the same as a request to authenticate execution. Record the scenario before judging a gate.
- The old scratchpad/make-r02.py provenance reference is stale; the generator is in this directory.
- check:gates skips testdata. A green static check does not reconcile these expectations.

Resolve disputed expectations in a separately reviewed behavior/oracle change before using them as a release gate. Do not silently translate a mismatch into a passing test.

## Reproducible use

1. Select cases and record the team commit, member lock, model, knowledge pack, scenario and expected categories.
2. Copy **only input contracts** into a fresh review workspace. Keep ground-truth.yaml, expected-result notes and generators outside the agents' visible scope.
3. Submit contracts through the normal user interface with role, jurisdiction, attachments and review purpose. Do not prefill findings.
4. Capture real member receipts, original evidence, output files, timestamps and explicit failure states. Record any operator intervention.
5. Compare externally against reviewed expectations, including must-not-flag cases, uncovered checks, referral and Human Gate behavior.
6. Repeat representative inputs in at least three isolated runs; compare gate, coverage, evidence and deliverable categories rather than wording.
7. For DOCX acceptance use an available tracked-change exporter and Word-compatible viewer; follow [the document checks](../../docs/testing.md). Markdown renamed to .docx or manual ZIP generation is not proof of an autonomous export.

Synthetic business confirmations may be explicitly simulated and logged; never present them as real legal approval. Re-generating fixtures changes test inputs: review the diff and expected results together. No automatic full E2E runner is supplied by package.json.
